sentences.en: The photo catches the tension in the court very well.
sentences.zh: 这张照片很好地捕捉到了法庭上的紧张气氛。

sentences.en: The accused is to appear before the court on Friday.
The accused made up a false story in the court.
sentences.zh: 被告在法庭上编造了一个谎言。

phrases.zh: 属于法庭的；由法庭决定的

senses.zh: 招致（失败、危险等）；向…献殷勤；设法获得
